reference: Earlier calendar years only; matched days within each calendar month; OLS linear trend; minimum ten years.
limitations: National temperature and rainfall extractions are not included.
State aggregates are not synthesized from incomplete local coverage.
No monthly ENSO-conditioned expectations or yield update are fitted.
Product cutoffs are capped at the frozen release inputs; composites are final-vintage observations.

temperature.name: CPC daily temperature, Berkeley-adjusted
temperature.note: Each month is compared with the same adjusted CPC product. The existing CPC extract records SPAM weights; no new weighting or product splice is applied.

rainfall.name: CHIRPS v2.0, including preliminary 2026 days
rainfall.note: Monthly totals require all elapsed daily values. Units served only by ERA5 in the archive remain missing.

ndvi.name: NOAA STAR Blended VHP smoothed NDVI
ndvi.note: Weekly composites are weighted by overlapping days. Partial-month references exclude composites ending after the matched cutoff.
